assumptions: The design's Phase 1 sequencing remains canonical.
FF-DEC-002 remains the only approved ordinary product transport dependency decision.
No shipped runnable fforager entrypoint currently exists, so all runnable behavior claimed here must be created and proven in this packet.

The current ff.runtime-proof@1 executor is insufficient; this packet definitely requires a backwards-compatible proof-contract and gate extension for multiple artifacts and actors, deterministic origin supervision, ordered cancellation/restart actions, semantic durable-state inspection, and a real behavior/state counterfactual.
non_goals: Broad crate scaffolding or planned-command documentation.

minimum_controls: Strict runtime proof is immutable from activation.
The exact release artifact executes outside source/build/governance roots.
At least one success and one nonzero negative scenario cross real production boundaries.
Every required effect remains pending until acknowledged.
Watcher failure preserves identical product semantics.
A declaration-preserving behavior mutation is rejected.
An independent validator reruns the proof producer, and exact dependency/closure/main-containment negative fixtures fail closed.
No Phase 2 or broad-readiness claim is emitted.
plausible_failures: The binary starts but does not acquire media.
The happy path bypasses production transport or storage.
Cancellation leaves a task, handle, partial final output, or archive row.
Recovery advances beyond durable bytes or reports success early.
Watcher absence changes output or exit behavior.
The runtime gate observes a fixture helper instead of the product boundary.
WP-FF-011 activates from ranged, alternative, superseded, unvalidated, or uncontained dependency prose because no executable dependency check ran.
